taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: Unsafe file upload and processing — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace multipart receipt, type validation, storage key/permissions, download headers, ownership and every downstream processor. Define which consumer is supposed to interpret the file.
controls.controlled_verification: Use harmless uniquely marked fixtures for the actual parser/render/download path. Compare an allowed file with one boundary case derived from source or parser behavior. Observe whether it is served as active same-origin content, processed with excess authority, or readable by a prohibited account; keep each cause distinct.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An accepted extension or unusual MIME value alone is not execution. A safely isolated attachment can be intentional. Successful upload does not establish retrieval or processor behavior.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Repair the evidenced validation/storage/publication/processor boundary, not only the client extension check. Retest valid uploads, the original consumer path and recipient/owner access.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
